name: Make a home page
description: Introduce yourself and give your work a home.
firstTask: Open Home page → Edit content → Site settings. Replace the name and tagline with your own.
collaboratorTask: Help me make this home page my own. Ask what I make and who it is for, then update the name and tagline together.
finishLine: A personal home page you can publish and send to someone.
example: Moss & Morning — a maker’s home page

name: Make a small game
description: Remix a playable pocket game, one change at a time.
firstTask: Open Pocket game → Artifacts → game.json. Change the title, save, then play in Workshop → Clean.
collaboratorTask: Read game.json and help me change the title and target score. Keep it playable and test a full round with me.
finishLine: A playable browser game with your own title and rules.
example: Firefly Catch — collect a little light

name: Write a short book
description: Turn an outline and two sample chapters into a book.
firstTask: Open Manuscript → Use app. Open The first page and replace its opening paragraph with your own.
collaboratorTask: Read the outline and the first chapter. Ask about my voice, then help revise one paragraph without rewriting the rest.
finishLine: A public reading edition and a downloadable EPUB.
example: Small Hours — a two-chapter field notebook

name: Launch a small business
description: Shape an offer, plan a launch and put up a site.
firstTask: Open Business site → Edit content → Site settings. Change the business name and description to describe your offer.
collaboratorTask: Read the launch notebook. Help me describe one concrete offer for one audience, then update the business site with me.
finishLine: A business home page with an offer and a way to get in touch.
example: Bloom & Ink — an imaginary illustration studio

name: Explore a question
description: Keep observations, inspect a small dataset and share findings.
firstTask: Open Findings → Artifacts → observations.csv. Change one height value, save, and inspect the updated chart in Workshop → Clean.
collaboratorTask: Read the question and observations.csv. Help me interpret the pattern, distinguish observation from causation, and revise the findings together.
finishLine: A findings page with the data, a chart and clear limitations.
example: Seed trial — a small synthetic dataset

name: Tell a family history
description: Collect memories and turn them into a small reading collection.
firstTask: Open Family journal → Edit content. Open the sample post and replace its title and opening paragraph with a memory you want to share.
collaboratorTask: Read the memory notebook and ask me about one place or object. Help shape my answers into a short story, keeping uncertain details marked.
finishLine: A public journal containing only the memories you choose to share.
example: The blue kitchen — an invented family story
